moduleVersion.description: Optional. The Go module's semantic version in the form vX.Y.Z. e.g. v0.1.1 Pre-release identifiers can also be added by appending a dash and dot separated ASCII alphanumeric characters and hyphens. e.g. v0.2.3-alpha.x.12m.5

repositoryProjectId.description: Optional. Project ID of the Artifact Registry repository. Defaults to the build project.

repositoryLocation.description: Optional. Location of the Artifact Registry repository. i.e. us-east1 Defaults to the build’s location.

repositoryName.description: Optional. Artifact Registry repository name. Specified Go modules will be zipped and uploaded to Artifact Registry with this location as a prefix. e.g. my-go-repo

sourcePath.description: Optional. Source path of the go.mod file in the build's workspace. If not specified, this will default to the current directory. e.g. ~/code/go/mypackage

modulePath.description: Optional. The Go module's "module path". e.g. example.com/foo/v2

GoModule.description: Go module to upload to Artifact Registry upon successful completion of all build steps. A module refers to all dependencies in a go.mod file.

branch.description: Regexes matching branches to build. The syntax of the regular expressions accepted is the syntax accepted by RE2 and described at https://github.com/google/re2/wiki/Syntax

tag.description: Regexes matching tags to build. The syntax of the regular expressions accepted is the syntax accepted by RE2 and described at https://github.com/google/re2/wiki/Syntax

invertRegex.description: When true, only trigger a build if the revision regex does NOT match the git_ref regex.

groupId.description: Maven `groupId` value used when uploading the artifact to Artifact Registry.

deployFolder.description: Optional. Path to a folder containing the files to upload to Artifact Registry. This can be either an absolute path, e.g. `/workspace/my-app/target/`, or a relative path from /workspace, e.g. `my-app/target/`. This field is mutually exclusive with the `path` field.

repository.description: Artifact Registry repository, in the form "https://$REGION-maven.pkg.dev/$PROJECT/$REPOSITORY" Artifact in the workspace specified by path will be uploaded to Artifact Registry with this location as a prefix.

artifactId.description: Maven `artifactId` value used when uploading the artifact to Artifact Registry.

version.description: Maven `version` value used when uploading the artifact to Artifact Registry.

path.description: Optional. Path to an artifact in the build's workspace to be uploaded to Artifact Registry. This can be either an absolute path, e.g. /workspace/my-app/target/my-app-1.0.SNAPSHOT.jar or a relative path from /workspace, e.g. my-app/target/my-app-1.0.SNAPSHOT.jar.
